title: Colorado hunting licenses, draws, and fees
intro: Most deer licenses and many elk licenses are limited (draw). Some elk licenses sell over the counter by unit and season. Fees change; confirm on CPWshop before you pay.

whereToBuy.title: CPWshop online
whereToBuy.body: Buy licenses and enter draws at https://www.cpwshop.com/.

whereToBuy.title: License agent
whereToBuy.body: CPW license agents sell OTC products and can help with applications.

whereToBuy.title: Limited license draw
whereToBuy.body: Primary and secondary draws award limited deer, elk, pronghorn, and other big-game licenses. Preference points apply by species.

whereToBuy.title: Over the counter
whereToBuy.body: Selected elk (and some other) licenses sell OTC by season and unit list — see CPW OTC page.

whereToBuy.title: Phone
whereToBuy.body: CPW customer service can process some license sales by phone. Confirm current hours.

deadlines.name: Big-game draw application (typical)
deadlines.detail: Confirm the exact 2026 primary-draw deadline in the Big Game brochure.

deadlines.name: Archery deer/elk (west of I-25)
deadlines.detail: Opens Sept 2; closes Sept 30, 2026 per BGSS 2025–2029.

preferencePoints: Colorado uses preference points for limited deer, elk, pronghorn, and moose licenses.
OTC elk licenses do not use preference points.
Leftover limited licenses, when offered, are a separate sale after the draws.
